description: Trigger: block_cache.rs evict_for() performs one COUNT/SUM query to find how many bytes to reclaim, then queries each LRU entry individually in a loop. Bad behavior: for large eviction runs (e.g. 10,000 entries to evict), this is 10,001 sequential SQLite queries instead of one DELETE with ORDER BY. On a large cache this causes multi-second pauses in the cache eviction path, blocking concurrent IPFS write operations.
title: block_cache evict_for does O(n) sequential per-entry queries for large eviction runs
